replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Evocal = Homestuck. Lil Cal (-cal) and just prefix Evo because it sounded cool (:

MonsieurGray = My friends call me Gray and Monsieur sounded cool :^)

Astronis = Name of a player from a game I used to play called Tibia.

UmbreonMessiah = YouTuber's name, username that started the Messiah squad.

Evoclaws = Skype username.

timaeusTestified = Dirk Strider's chumhandle from Homestuck. Very demanded name around the Homestuck fandom B)

Darkiur_ = My ex-neighbor's Tibia player name. Old times ):
